vm80a
=====

The vm80a_sim binary contains a simulation model compiled from vm80a
(org/rtl/vm80a.v), copyright (c) 2014-2018 by 1801BM1,
https://github.com/1801BM1/vm80a, licensed under Creative Commons
Attribution 3.0 (CC BY 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/;
full text in CC-BY-3.0.md).

The model is derived from the reverse-engineered die of the KR580VM80A and is
used unmodified (source/vm80a.v is the file at the revision listed in
LICENSES.md and manifest.json). The testbench around it (source/harness.v)
is part of retrocpu-tools and is under its licence.
